headline: Executive session to interview Business Manager candidates, plus possible approval of a Business Manager appointment.
summary: The board will meet in executive session to interview candidates for Business Manager. It will also consider accepting resignations and retirements, and discuss possible approval of a Business Manager appointment.
items: Executive session: interviews, discussion, and possible action on candidates for Business Manager
Discussion and possible approval of appointment of candidate for Business Manager
location: Board of Education Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Boulevard, Wallingford
